t: When you have made your choice
a: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
p: Rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wa-ttabaʿna-r-rasūla fa-ktubnā maʿa-sh-shāhidīn.
m: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger [i.e., Jesus], so register us among the witnesses [to truth]."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
